div.div: سَهِكٌ Having a disagreeable smell proceeding from sweat. (K.) You say, إِنَّهُ لَسَهِكُ الرِّيحِ Verily he is one who has a disagreeable smell, &c. (Moheet, L.) And يَدِى مِنَ السَّمَكِ وَمِنْ صَدَأِ الحَدِيدِ سَهِكَةٌ [My hand is disagreeable in smell from fish and from the rust of iron]; like as you say وَضِرَةٌ when it is from milk and butter, and غَمِرَةٌ when it is from flesh-meat. (S.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
